[inform] -- Flexible Survival -- Survive the nanobot apocalypse.

Chaos has broken loose, while you hide away in your bunker. After a while, as supplies start to run low, you emerge to find the world a vastly different place.

This is a text game using inform. While there are some pictures, their fairly rare, and the game relies on vivid descriptions to detail the world to you.

The gameplay is based around exploration, quests, and fighting -- losing fights causes the nanites (which have infected everything) to transform you into whatever decided to take a victory dance in your ass. Quests can be used to extend the time until the army invades. Exploration reveals and incredibly large and detailed world, with a crazy number of events, places, things, and people to explore and do. Like CoC and TiTs, this game tends to apply anthropomorphic changes (aka. furry) to the player, though there are things like demons, tentacled monstrosities, etc., as well. It's a pretty awesome game to lose your time in.

Oh, and there's a multiplayer version, which I haven't tried out yet. I'll assume it's good unless someone tells me otherwise.
